description: The file defines the SsoTokenProvider class, which manages fetching, refreshing, and caching SSO tokens from AWS's SSO provider using OIDC. It includes methods for resolving profiles and config files, validating tokens, and interacting with the file system for token caching.

classes.name: SsoTokenProvider
classes.description: Class responsible for providing AWS SSO tokens, handling their retrieval, refresh, validation, and local caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with profile info, config file path, and optional OIDC client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and returns a valid SSO token as a Promise.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Attempts to refresh the token if within refresh window; otherwise, returns current token data.

methods.name: shouldAttemptRefresh
methods.description: Determines whether a token refresh should be attempted based on last refresh time and expiry.

methods.name: getTokenLocation
methods.description: Generates the file path for cached token data based on sso session name.

methods.name: getTokenData
methods.description: Reads and decodes token JSON data from the cache file.

methods.name: validateTokenData
methods.description: Validates presence and correctness of 'accessToken' and 'expiresAt' in token data.

methods.name: writeNewTokenDataToDisk
methods.description: Saves the updated token data to disk with proper expiration format.

methods.name: resolveProfileName
methods.description: Determines the profile name from argument, environment variable, or default.

methods.name: resolveConfigFile
methods.description: Determines the config file path from argument or default location.
